description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmploymentStatusAPITest' that tests the 'EmploymentStatusAPI' class. It includes setup methods, data providers, and test methods for CRUD operations (get all, get one, create, update, delete) related to employment status entities within the OrangeHRM system.
